lines.en: Fixies are such itty -bitty creatures.
lines.zh: 你能相信吗？这些小家伙们真是太小了

lines.en: Even when they're magnified It's hard to see their features.
lines.zh: 即使放大镜也很难看清它们的图案。

lines.en: They're tiny, infinitesimal, so small it makes you doubt.
lines.zh: 它们太小了，小到令人怀疑。

lines.en: But if you meet a Fixie, please, Don't let their secret out!
lines.zh: 但如果你遇到了修理工，千万别泄露他们的秘密。

lines.en: But if you meet a Fixie, please, Don't let their secret out!
lines.zh: 但如果你遇到了修理工，千万别泄露他们的秘密。

lines.en: The Pen
lines.zh: 笔

lines.en: Not here either.
lines.zh: 也不在这里。

lines.en: Tom Thomas, are you looking for me?
lines.zh: 托马斯，你在找我吗？

lines.en: No, for a red pen. I need it right now.
lines.zh: 不，我在找一支红笔，我现在就需要它。

lines.en: What do you need it for?
lines.zh: 你要它做什么？

lines.en: Here, look what my teacher wrote in my assignment book.
lines.zh: 看看我的老师在我的作业本上写了什么：上课表现不好

lines.en: Bad behavior during the lesson. Fidgeting and talking.
lines.zh: 坐立不安，说话。

lines.en: What are you going to do with the red pen?
lines.zh: 你打算怎么处理这支红笔？

lines.en: Your teacher left something out?
lines.zh: 你的老师漏掉了什么。

lines.en: I thought maybe, you know, I could fix it a bit.
lines.zh: 我想也许你可以帮我修改一下。

lines.en: I hope I find that pen.
lines.zh: 我希望我能找到那支笔。

lines.en: Oh! Oh, wow! Good catch!
lines.zh: 哦，什么？什么？哇，好眼力！

lines.en: So, what do you want to fix on it?
lines.zh: 那你想修改什么？

lines.en: I'll just add a couple of no's.
lines.zh: 我只要加几个鼻子

lines.en: And then it will say that I had no bad behavior during the lesson,
lines.zh: 然后它就会写着我上课表现良好

lines.en: no fidgeting, and no talking. See? No problem!
lines.zh: 没有坐立不安，也没有说话。你看

lines.en: Cool! And then add this at the end.
lines.zh: 没问题。酷！

lines.en: Tom Thomas is a perfect student!
lines.zh: 然后在最后加上这句话：托马斯是个完美的小家伙。

lines.en: Nah, then they would guess I didn't. What, is it clogged up?
lines.zh: 学生，不，那他们就会猜是我干的。怎么回事？

lines.en: A little scribble will do it. That's not a pen.
lines.zh: 堵塞了。随便涂涂画画就行了。那不是笔

lines.en: It's more like a pen knife. Oh, look!
lines.zh: 更像小刀。哦，看

lines.en: The ball's missing! What ball? It's a pen!
lines.zh: 笔尖的珠子不见了。什么珠子？是笔，是笔

lines.en: It's a pen! But it's a ballpoint pen!
lines.zh: 但它是圆珠笔。

lines.en: Old -fashioned pens work by dipping the pen into a jar of ink.
lines.zh: 老式钢笔是把笔尖蘸进墨水罐里用的

lines.en: But with a ballpoint pen,
lines.zh: 但圆珠笔

lines.en: the ink is stored inside of a tube that has
lines.zh: 墨水储存在一个管子里

lines.en: a metal tip on the end with a small steel ball.
lines.zh: 管子末端有一个金属笔尖，上面有一个小钢珠。嗯

lines.en: Well, small for humans that is, but of course for Fixies it's quite large.
lines.zh: 对人来说很小，但对骑固定齿轮自行车的人来说，它就很大了。

lines.en: When you drag the pen across the paper,
lines.zh: 当你用笔在纸上划动时

lines.en: the ball spins around and gets ink on it from inside the tube.
lines.zh: 钢珠会旋转，从管子里沾上墨水

lines.en: Then it turns over and the ink rolls out onto the paper.
lines.zh: 然后翻转过来，墨水滚到纸上。

lines.en: So without the ball, a ball point pen won't write at all!
lines.zh: 所以没有钢珠，圆珠笔就写不出字了。

lines.en: So what am I going to do?
lines.zh: 那我该怎么办？

lines.en: That's my only red pen.
lines.zh: 这是我唯一的红笔。

lines.en: Hi, everybody! Why do you look so sad?
lines.zh: 大家好，你们为什么看起来这么难过？

lines.en: We lost the ball from the tip of this pen.
lines.zh: 呃，我们把这支笔尖上的钢珠弄丢了

lines.en: Where? It's here somewhere.
lines.zh: 它应该在哪儿？

lines.en: Then you're in luck, boys! In the pack -o -map, there's a metal detector.
lines.zh: 那你们运气真好，伙计们，包里有一张地图，还有一个金属探测器。

lines.en: You can use it to find different kinds of metal objects.
lines.zh: 可以用它来寻找各种金属物品。

lines.en: Nah, that's not it. I can see that myself.
lines.zh: 伙计，不是这个，我自己也看到了

lines.en: It's not on the table, Nolik.
lines.zh: 它不在桌子上。不，你看

lines.en: Until not that long ago, humans used pens that had to be
lines.zh: 直到不久前

lines.en: dipped over and over again into an inkwell.
lines.zh: 人类使用的钢笔需要反复蘸墨水

lines.en: This was quite inconvenient.
lines.zh: 这很不方便。

lines.en: And so to make writing easier, the fountain pen was invented.
lines.zh: 为了方便书写，人们发明了钢笔。

lines.en: A fountain pen could be filled up with ink
lines.zh: 钢笔可以装满墨水

lines.en: so it could write for a much longer time.
lines.zh: 因此可以书写更长时间

lines.en: But fountain pens would often leak, leaving blots of ink on the paper.
lines.zh: 但钢笔经常漏墨，在纸上留下墨迹。

lines.en: This problem was solved with the invention of the ball -point pen.
lines.zh: 圆珠笔的发明解决了这个问题。

lines.en: Ball -point pens are simple, handy, and reliable,
lines.zh: 圆珠笔简单、方便、可靠

lines.en: except that you can't write with them on
lines.zh: 只是不能长时间

lines.en: a wall or upside down for a long time.
lines.zh: 在墙上或倒置书写

lines.en: That's because the ball uses up the ink on
lines.zh: 因为笔尖的圆珠会消耗掉上面的墨水

lines.en: it and the ink can't flow up to the tip.
lines.zh: 墨水无法流到笔尖。

lines.en: But even this problem has been solved.
lines.zh: 但即使是这个问题也得到了解决

lines.en: There are now special ball -point pens that
lines.zh: 现在有特殊圆珠笔

lines.en: can be used by astronauts floating in space.
lines.zh: 宇航员在太空漂浮时可以使用

lines.en: Is this the one? You're right! That's it!
lines.zh: 是这个吗？你说得对，就是它。

lines.en: Don't you just see how awesome my metal detector is?
lines.zh: 你没看到我的金属探测器有多棒吗？你指的是这个吗？

lines.en: Is that what you're calling me now?
lines.zh: 现在

lines.en: I'm going to get you!
lines.zh: 我要抓住你！

lines.en: Tom Thomas, help us! And now! Tideesh!
lines.zh: 汤姆·托马斯帮帮我们

lines.en: Cool! By the way, what do you need the red pen for?
lines.zh: 对了，你要红笔干什么？嗯

lines.en: Well, Tom Thomas and I needed to fix something in his assignment book. What?!
lines.zh: 汤姆·托马斯和我需要修改他作业本上的一些东西。

lines.en: If I knew that, I wouldn't have helped you out!
lines.zh: 如果我知道的话，我就不会帮你们了。

lines.en: So, no fidgeting and no talking.
lines.zh: 所以别乱动，也别说话。

lines.en: And your teacher?
lines.zh: 嗯

lines.en: She writes in your assignment book when you behave like a child.
lines.zh: 你们的老师会在你们表现好的时候在作业本上写点什么。

lines.en: Well, uh -huh whenever we behave well,
lines.zh: 嗯哼，每当我们表现好的时候

lines.en: she writes a note in our books right away.
lines.zh: 她都会立刻在我们的作业本上写点什么。

lines.en: Ah did you see Simka how Tom Thomas managed to outsmart everybody?
lines.zh: 啊，辛卡，你看到汤姆·托马斯是怎么耍了所有人吗？

lines.en: Since I see nothing else here from your teacher.
lines.zh: 既然我没看到你老师的其他留言

lines.en: Does that mean you behave badly the other days?
lines.zh: 那是不是意味着你前几天表现不好？

lines.en: Uh -huh what?
lines.zh: 嗯哼。什么？

lines.en: well did you see Nolik how Tom Thomas just managed to outsmart himself?
lines.zh: 嗯，你看到诺里克是怎么耍了汤姆·托马斯的吗？

lines.en: Can you believe that?
lines.zh: 他自己。你相信固定齿轮是如此
